title: A spreading geometrically irreducible affine chart in a generically integral family
statement: Let $X$ be reduced affine, let $S$ be integral affine [def-pc-integral-scheme], and let $f:X\to S$ be flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally finitely presented [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Let $\eta$ be a generic point of $S$ and suppose $X_\eta$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre] is geometrically irreducible and geometrically reduced [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. There exist an affine open $W\subseteq X$ and an open $U\subseteq S$ containing $\eta$ such that the fibres $W_s$ are geometrically irreducible for all $s\in U$. No density assertion about $W_s\subseteq X_s$ and no irreducibility assertion about $X_s$ is included.

proof.text: Apply the common generic hypersurface affine-open theorem to obtain an affine W, a concrete hypersurface H with generically geometrically integral fibre, and an open immersion i:W to H over S, with eta in the image of W to S.
Apply the hypersurface specialization theorem to obtain an open U containing eta on which every H fibre is geometrically irreducible.

Flatness and local finite presentation of W to S follow from the open immersion W to X. Mathlib UniversallyOpen.of_flat makes its image V open. The construction puts eta in V; intersect U and V. For every s in this intersection, fiberHomeo and the image witness give a nonempty W fibre. Base-change i to an open immersion of fibres, whose composite to Spec kappa(s) is surjective because the source is nonempty and the target is a singleton. Mathlib geometrically irreducible open-immersion instance transfers the property from H_s to W_s. This is the Lean proof and requires no density theorem or further shrinking.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_generic_geometrically_integral_affine_chart
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsReduced X] [IsAffine S] [IsIntegral S]
    (f : X ⟶ S) [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (η : S) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ)
    (hgeom : GeometricallyIrreducible (f.fiberToSpecResidueField η))
    (hred : GeometricallyReduced (f.fiberToSpecResidueField η)) :
    ∃ W : X.Opens, IsAffineOpen W ∧ ∃ U : S.Opens, η ∈ U ∧
      ∀ s, s ∈ U → GeometricallyIrreducible ((W.ι ≫ f).fiberToSpecResidueField s)
